items.title: SLB (SLB) Could Be 20% Below Fair Value After New Contract Wins
items.summary: Why SLB Stock Is Back in Focus After New Contract Wins SLB (SLB) just picked up fresh attention after Aker BP awarded its OneSubsea unit a contract for the Lyra field offshore Norway and Crescent Petroleum signed a three year digital planning deal. Those fresh contracts have landed while SLB’s share price has been choppy in the short term. The stock is down 7.11% on a 7 day share price return, yet it still shows a 24.18% year to date share price return and a 39.50% total shareholder return...

items.title: Why Is SLB (SLB) Pairing A Norway Contract With New Production Chemistry?
items.summary: SLB (NYSE:SLB) secured a major subsea production systems contract from Aker BP for the Lyra field offshore Norway. The Lyra award uses SLB's standardized subsea technology that is aimed at shortening offshore field development timelines. SLB introduced a new ChampionX nano-enabled chemistry portfolio intended to improve oil and gas output in mature reservoirs.
